_readme: Every word the app says, in one file. Nothing user-facing is written in a component.
SHAPE: `strings` is keyed by string, not by language — one row carries all four
variants side by side, so you can see at a glance which are missing and edit a
sentence across every language at once.
FALLBACK: a locale with nothing of its own inherits down its `fallback` chain, so
ar-SA only needs the rows where the Saudi dialect actually differs from fus7a, and
en-LB only the rows that get the Lebanese flavour. Leave a locale out of a row and
it inherits. That is the normal case, not an omission.
PLURALS: a value may be an object of plural categories instead of a string. English
uses one/other; Arabic uses zero/one/two/few/many/other and is selected with
Intl.PluralRules. `=0`, `=1` etc. are exact-match overrides that win over category.
PLACEHOLDERS: `{name}` is substituted at render. Keep every placeholder a
translation receives — a dropped one shows up as a literal `{name}` on screen.
WHO GETS WHAT: see `regions` below. Region comes from the device timezone (and is
double-checked against Cloudflare's view of the request); language comes from the
device's own preference list. An explicit choice in the language switcher beats both.

ar-LB.label: Arabic
ar-LB._formatLocale: Gregorian forced: the Hijri calendar is ar-SA's Intl default and would misdate an event the host set in Gregorian. Latin digits forced so interpolated counts and formatted dates don't end up in two different numeral systems — drop `-nu-latn` to use Arabic-Indic digits throughout.

ar-SA.label: Arabic (Saudi)
ar-SA._fallback: Saudi dialect falls back to fus7a, not to English — so this column only carries the lines where the dialect genuinely differs.

account.closeError.ar-SA: ما قدرنا نسكّر الحساب، جرّب مرة ثانية.

reset.badLink.en: That link didn't work. It may have expired — ask for a new one from your account page.
reset.badLink.ar-LB: لم يعمل هذا الرابط. ربما انتهت صلاحيته — اطلب رابطاً جديداً من صفحة حسابك.
reset.badLink.ar-SA: الرابط ما اشتغل. يمكن انتهت صلاحيته — اطلب واحد جديد من صفحة حسابك.

seo.defaultTitle.en: Sawwerna — a disposable camera for your event

seo.defaultDescription.en: Hand your guests a disposable camera that lives in their browser. They join by QR — no app, no download — and the whole album reveals when the event ends.
seo.defaultDescription.ar-LB: أعطِ ضيوفك كاميرا تعيش داخل متصفحهم. ينضمّون عبر رمز QR — بلا تطبيق وبلا تحميل — ويُكشف الألبوم كاملاً عند انتهاء المناسبة.
seo.defaultDescription.ar-SA: اعطِ ضيوفك كاميرا داخل المتصفح. يدخلون عن طريق رمز QR — بدون تطبيق وبدون تحميل — والألبوم كله ينكشف لما تخلص المناسبة.

shared.closedBody.en: The album it pointed at is no longer being shared. Ask whoever sent it for a fresh link.
shared.closedBody.ar-LB: لم يعد الألبوم الذي يشير إليه هذا الرابط مُشارَكاً. اطلب رابطاً جديداً ممّن أرسله لك.
shared.closedBody.ar-SA: الألبوم اللي يوديله الرابط ما عاد مشارك. اطلب رابط جديد من اللي أرسله لك.

shared.noMoments.en: No moments were captured at this one.
shared.noMoments.ar-LB: لم تُلتقط أي لحظة في هذه المناسبة.
shared.noMoments.ar-SA: ما انصوّرت ولا لحظة بهذي المناسبة.

shared.yourTurnBody.en: Hand everyone a camera at your next event and see the night through their eyes.
shared.yourTurnBody.ar-LB: أعطِ كل ضيف كاميرا في مناسبتك القادمة وشاهد الليلة من عيونهم.
shared.yourTurnBody.ar-SA: اعطِ كل ضيف كاميرا بمناسبتك الجاية وشوف الليلة من عيونهم.
